# Discussion categories

Create these categories after publishing the repository:

| Category      | Use for                                                     |
| ---------------| -------------------------------------------------------------|
| Announcements | Releases and maintainers' updates                           |
| Ideas         | Early suggestions and open questions                        |
| RFC           | Changes to skill behavior, methodology, or structural rules |
| Case studies  | Sanitized adoption reports using the benchmark protocol     |
| Q&A           | Installation, agent compatibility, and adoption help        |
| Show and tell | External adapters, examples, and integrations               |

## Suggested first RFC prompts

1. Is “three stable callers before extraction” a useful default, or should extraction be governed by another observable signal?
2. Should cross-module contracts stay with their owning module, or is a dedicated contract layer ever justified?
3. Which project-map facts can be automatically checked without turning the map into generated documentation?
4. When should a coding agent run local validation automatically versus hand it to the target environment?
